image_prompt.text: A chain of ten floating neon platforms of varying size and height — magenta, purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, pink, white, teal and lime — zigzagging from a bright cyan start platform in one corner as the ordered route through the course
A glowing red-orange neon lava floor covering the entire base at ground level, lethal on contact to anyone who falls onto it

Two neon gradient ramps connecting platforms and two dark neon walls with glowing edges that have to be jumped around, between long horizontal gaps and stepped rises as the platform heights climb then vary
Four flat golden neon checkpoint platforms set at intervals along the zigzag, each marked by a glowing ring
A bright green neon finish platform at the far corner, dressed for a celebration

layout_placement.text: Respawn points on the four checkpoint platforms, so a fall into the lava returns the player to the last one reached instead of the start
The end reward area on the finish platform at the far corner, triggered on completing the course

notes: Classic Obby kept on its own shape course-flat, with obstacle-moving dropped because the prompt specifies every part anchored and static, and hazard-kill plus winner-zone added for the lava floor and the finish platform.

Close shape call: heights 'gradually increase then vary', but progression is corner-to-corner across a wide footprint rather than up a hillside, so course-flat rather than course-terraced; no platform sits directly above another, so no P2.

The stated gaps of 10-20 studs, and the hard setting of 25, exceed the P6 horizontal limit of 11 studs at default WalkSpeed/JumpHeight. Either the spacing needs tightening or the course needs boosted movement stats for the generated path to stay clearable.
Prompt states a 2048x2048 stud footprint at Y=0; the scale band cannot carry the exact figure.

The requested editable attributes (platformColor, lavaColor, jumpDifficulty, platformSize, neonIntensity) and the Anchored/CanCollide requirement are authoring parameters rather than layout features, and nothing in this handoff carries them.
